University.title: University
University.description: Represents a university institution registered with Dash, managing global configurations and allowing multi-tenancy.

id.description: Unique identifier for the University entity.

name.description: The full name of the university.

domainAllowlist.description: A list of allowed institutional email domains for user registration (e.g., 'univ.cm').

faculties.description: A list of faculties available at the university for student affiliation.

departments.description: A list of departments available at the university for student affiliation.

campusMapImageUrl.description: Cloudinary URL for the static campus map image, used for event location pinning.

currency.description: The currency code used for marketplace listings (e.g., 'XAF').

welcomeMessage.description: A customizable welcome message displayed to new users upon completing onboarding.

aiAssistEnabled.description: A flag indicating whether AI assistance features are enabled for administrators in this university.

enableMarketplace.description: A flag to enable or disable the Campus Marketplace feature for this university.

enableTimetable.description: A flag to enable or disable the Course Timetable Viewer feature for this university.

enableLostFound.description: A flag to enable or disable the Lost & Found Board feature for this university.

maintenanceMode.description: A flag to put the university's platform into maintenance mode, restricting user access.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the university entity was created.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile on the Dash platform, storing personal information, roles, and preferences.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

username.description: A unique, alphanumeric identifier for the user, immutable after creation (3-30 chars, alphanumeric and underscores).

avatarUrl.description: Cloudinary URL for the user's profile picture.

coverPhotoUrl.description: Cloudinary URL for the user's cover photo.

yearOfStudy.description: The user's current year of study (1-7).

role.description: The user's role on the platform: 'student', 'admin', 'superadmin', 'wellbeing_admin'.

isVerified.description: True if the user's email address has been verified.

isActive.description: True if the user's account is active and not soft-deleted.

isSuspended.description: True if the user's account is currently suspended.

suspensionReason.description: The reason provided for account suspension.

suspensionTime.description: Timestamp when the account was suspended.

suspendedByUserId.description: Reference to UserProfile. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N UserProfile - Admin suspended student)

fcmToken.description: The Firebase Cloud Messaging token for the user's current device, used for push notifications.

fcmTokens.description: A list of up to 5 FCM tokens for multi-device push notifications.

notificationPrefs.description: A map where keys are notification types (e.g., 'postLike') and values are booleans indicating user preference for receiving that notification.

quietHoursStart.description: Start time in HH:MM format for suppressing push notifications.

quietHoursEnd.description: End time in HH:MM format for suppressing push notifications.

followerIds.description: References to UserProfiles. IDs of users who follow this user. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N UserProfile)

followingIds.description: References to UserProfiles. IDs of users this user is following. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N UserProfile)

blockedUserIds.description: References to UserProfiles. IDs of users blocked by this user. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N UserProfile)

onboardingComplete.description: True if the initial onboarding wizard has been completed by the user.

twoFactorEnabled.description: True if Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) is enabled for the user.

lastSeenAt.description: Timestamp of the user's last active presence on the platform.

postCount.description: Denormalized count of posts created by the user.

socialLink.description: Optional social media profile link for the user.

Post.title: Post
Post.description: Represents a social media post created by a user, including text, media, and engagement metrics.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Post entity.

text.description: Main content of the post (max 1,000 characters).

mediaUrls.description: Cloudinary URLs for images/videos attached to the post (max 4 images or 1 video).

hashtagIds.description: References to Hashtags. IDs of hashtags associated with the post. (Relationship: Hashtag N:N Post)

likeUserIds.description: References to UserProfiles. IDs of users who liked the post. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Post)

commentCount.description: Denormalized count of comments on the post.

isAnnouncement.description: True if this post is also an official announcement (legacy/redundant if 'Announcement' entity is primary).

isDeleted.description: True if the post is soft-deleted for audit purposes.

isFlagged.description: True if the post has been flagged for moderation.

reportedByUniqueUserIds.description: References to UserProfiles. IDs of unique users who reported the post for auto-flagging logic. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Post)

contentWarningText.description: Text describing the content warning for the post (e.g., 'mental health', 'politics').

audience.description: The visibility setting for the post: 'Everyone' or 'Followers only'.

editedAt.description: Timestamp of the last edit to the post.

shareCount.description: Denormalized count of times the post's direct link has been copied/shared.

Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: Represents a comment made on a post.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Comment entity.

parentCommentId.description: Reference to Comment. ID of the parent comment if this is a reply. (Relationship: Comment 1:N Comment)

likeUserIds.description: References to UserProfiles. IDs of users who liked the comment. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Comment)

isDeleted.description: True if the comment is soft-deleted.

editedAt.description: Timestamp of the last edit to the comment.

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: Represents a direct message or group chat conversation between users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Conversation entity.

participantIds.description: References to UserProfiles. IDs of all users participating in the conversation. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Conversation)

isGroup.description: True if it's a group chat, false for 1-on-1 direct messages.

groupName.description: The name of the group chat.

groupAvatarUrl.description: URL for the group chat avatar.

groupAdminUserIds.description: References to UserProfiles. IDs of users with admin privileges in the group chat. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Conversation)

lastMessageText.description: Preview text of the last message in the conversation.

lastMessageAt.description: Timestamp of the last message in the conversation.

unreadCounts.description: A map where keys are UserProfile IDs and values are numbers representing unread message counts for that user in the conversation.

isBlocked.description: True if the conversation is blocked by one of the participants.

typingStatus.description: A map where keys are UserProfile IDs and values are date-time strings indicating the last time a user typed in the conversation.

isStudyGroup.description: True if this conversation is a study group chat.

courseCode.description: The course code if the conversation is a study group.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a single message within a conversation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Message entity.

mediaUrl.description: URL for attached media/file (Cloudinary or Firebase Storage).

mediaSize.description: Size of attached file in bytes.

parentMessageId.description: Reference to Message. ID of the message this one is replying to. (Relationship: Message 1:N Message)

reactions.description: A map where keys are emoji characters and values are arrays of UserProfile IDs who reacted with that emoji.

readByUserIds.description: References to UserProfiles. IDs of users who have read this message. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Message)

isDeleted.description: True if the message is soft-deleted.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: Represents an event created by a user or administrator.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Event entity.

description.description: Detailed description of the event (max 2,000 characters).

bannerImageUrl.description: Cloudinary URL for the event banner image.

locationName.description: Text description of the event location (max 200 characters).

locationType.description: The type of event location: 'In Person', 'Online', 'Hybrid'.

meetingLink.description: Meeting link for online events (if locationType is Online/Hybrid).

locationRoom.description: Specific room or building for in-person events.

campusMapPinCoordinates.description: Coordinates (latitude, longitude) for a pin on the campus map.

startDate.description: Start date and time of the event.

endDate.description: End date and time of the event.

isAllDay.description: True if the event spans a full day.

tagIds.description: References to Hashtags. IDs of tags associated with the event. (Relationship: Hashtag N:N Event)

rsvpGoingUserIds.description: References to UserProfiles. IDs of users who RSVP'd 'Going'. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Event)

rsvpMaybeUserIds.description: References to UserProfiles. IDs of users who RSVP'd 'Maybe'. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Event)

rsvpNotGoingUserIds.description: References to UserProfiles. IDs of users who RSVP'd 'Not Going'. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Event)

qrCodeSecret.description: Server-side secret for QR code check-in validation (not the QR code itself).

checkedInUserIds.description: References to UserProfiles. IDs of users who have checked in at the event. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Event)

isCancelled.description: True if the event is cancelled.

isOfficial.description: True if it's an official university event (admin-created).

EventPhoto.title: EventPhoto
EventPhoto.description: Represents a photo uploaded to a shared event album after an event.

id.description: Unique identifier for the EventPhoto entity.

Listing.title: Listing
Listing.description: Represents a marketplace listing created by a student.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Listing entity.

description.description: Detailed description of the item (max 1,000 characters).

imageUrls.description: Cloudinary URLs for images associated with the listing (up to 5 images).

price.description: Price of the item (0 for Free/Swap).

isNegotiable.description: True if the price is negotiable.

category.description: Category of the listing: 'Textbooks & Notes', 'Electronics', 'Furniture', 'Clothing', 'Stationery', 'Food & Meal Plans', 'Accommodation', 'Services', 'Other'.

condition.description: Condition grade of the item: 'New', 'Like New', 'Good', 'Fair', 'Poor'.

preferredPickupLocation.description: Optional preferred location for item pickup.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp when the listing will automatically expire.

interestedBuyerIds.description: References to UserProfiles. IDs of users who expressed interest in the listing. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Listing)

savedByUserIds.description: References to UserProfiles. IDs of users who saved/bookmarked the listing. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Listing)

viewCount.description: Denormalized count of times the listing has been viewed.

isRoommateFinder.description: True if this listing is part of the roommate finder sub-section.

roommateLocationPreference.description: Preferred location for a roommate, if applicable.

roommateBudget.description: Preferred budget for a roommate, if applicable.

roommateGenderPreference.description: Preferred gender for a roommate, if applicable.

roommateMoveInDate.description: Preferred move-in date for a roommate, if applicable.

HelpDeskTicket.title: HelpDeskTicket
HelpDeskTicket.description: Represents a support ticket submitted by a student to the help desk.

id.description: Unique identifier for the HelpDeskTicket entity.

description.description: Detailed description of the issue (max 2,000 characters).

attachmentUrls.description: URLs for attached files (PDF, images - max 10MB each, up to 3 files).

adminAssignedPriority.description: Admin-assigned priority for the ticket (can override student's).

status.description: Current status of the ticket: 'Open', 'In Progress', 'Resolved', 'Closed'.

assignedToUserId.description: Reference to UserProfile. ID of the admin/staff member assigned to the ticket. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N HelpDeskTicket)

resolvedAt.description: Timestamp when the ticket was resolved.

reopenedCount.description: Count of times the ticket was reopened after being marked resolved.

isWellbeingTicket.description: True if the category is 'Wellbeing', routing to a restricted queue.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update or reply to the ticket.

satisfactionRating.description: Student's rating of the resolution: 'Resolved', 'Partially Resolved', 'Unresolved'.

HelpDeskReply.title: HelpDeskReply
HelpDeskReply.description: Represents a reply within a help desk ticket thread.

id.description: Unique identifier for the HelpDeskReply entity.

attachmentUrls.description: URLs for attached files in the reply.

isFromAdmin.description: True if the sender of the reply is an administrator.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Represents an in-app or push notification sent to a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Notification entity.

text.description: Display text content of the notification.

link.description: Deep link URL to the relevant content in the app.

isRead.description: True if the notification has been read by the recipient.

actorId.description: Reference to UserProfile. ID of the user who triggered the notification (e.g., the one who liked a post). (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Notification)

meta.description: Additional metadata specific to the notification type (e.g., postId, commentId, conversationId).

Announcement.title: Announcement
Announcement.description: Represents an official university announcement broadcasted by an administrator, separate from regular posts for analytics.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Announcement entity.

authorId.description: Reference to UserProfile. ID of the admin who authored the announcement. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Announcement)

title.description: Optional title for the announcement (max 100 characters).

text.description: Body content of the announcement (max 1,000 characters).

targetType.description: Defines the target audience: 'All Students', 'By Year', 'By Faculty', 'By Department', 'Custom'.

targetYears.description: Specific years targeted (if targetType is By Year/Custom).

targetFaculty.description: Specific faculty targeted (if targetType is By Faculty/Custom).

targetDepartment.description: Specific department targeted (if targetType is By Department/Custom).

scheduledFor.description: Timestamp for future delivery if the announcement is scheduled.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp when the announcement expires from the feed's pinned position.

aiAssisted.description: True if AI assistance was used for drafting the announcement.

totalRecipientsCount.description: Estimated total recipients for the announcement.

fcmSentCount.description: Count of Firebase Cloud Messaging tokens sent to.

inAppImpressionsCount.description: Count of in-app feed impressions for the announcement.

uniqueOpensCount.description: Count of unique users who opened the announcement.

sentAt.description: Timestamp when the announcement was actually sent.

Club.title: Club
Club.description: Represents a student club or society page.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Club entity.

coverPhotoUrl.description: URL for the club's cover photo.

tagIds.description: References to Hashtags. IDs of tags associated with the club. (Relationship: Hashtag N:N Club)

adminUserId.description: Reference to UserProfile. ID of the main club administrator. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Club)

memberUserIds.description: References to UserProfiles. IDs of users who are members of the club. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Club)

moderatorUserIds.description: References to UserProfiles. IDs of users with moderator roles within the club. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Club)

isVerified.description: True if the club is official and admin-approved.

Poll.title: Poll
Poll.description: Represents a poll attached to a social media post.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Poll entity. Should match the parent Post ID for a 1:1 relationship.

options.description: An array of poll options, each with text and a denormalized vote count.

votedByUserIds.description: A map where keys are UserProfile IDs and values are numbers representing the index of the option the user voted for. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Poll)

expiresAt.description: Timestamp when the poll expires and voting is no longer allowed.

Report.title: Report
Report.description: Represents a report made by a user against content or another user for moderation review.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Report entity.

reporterId.description: Reference to UserProfile. ID of the user who submitted the report. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Report)

reportedEntityType.description: The type of entity being reported: 'Post', 'Comment', 'User', 'Listing', 'Event', 'Message'.

reportedEntityId.description: ID of the specific entity being reported.

categories.description: Categories of the report: 'Spam', 'Misinformation', 'Harassment', 'Hate speech', 'Inappropriate content', 'Intellectual property', 'Other'.

details.description: Optional text field for additional details provided by the reporter.

status.description: Current status of the report: 'Pending Review', 'Reviewed - Dismissed', 'Reviewed - Action Taken'.

moderatorAction.description: Description of the action taken by a moderator (e.g., 'Post Removed', 'User Suspended').

moderatorNotes.description: Internal notes from the moderator regarding the report.

moderatorId.description: Reference to UserProfile. ID of the moderator who handled the report. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Report)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the report was created.

resolvedAt.description: Timestamp when the report was resolved.

ModerationLog.title: ModerationLog
ModerationLog.description: An immutable log of all moderation actions performed by administrators for auditing purposes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ModerationLog entry.

moderatorId.description: Reference to UserProfile. ID of the administrator who performed the action. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ModerationLog)

actionType.description: The type of moderation action performed (e.g., 'Post Removed', 'User Suspended').

targetEntityType.description: The type of entity targeted by the action: 'Post', 'User', 'Announcement', 'HelpDeskTicket', 'Listing'.

targetEntityId.description: ID of the entity affected by the moderation action.

details.description: Detailed description of the action, including reasons, specific content, or duration.

Hashtag.title: Hashtag
Hashtag.description: Represents a hashtag used for content categorization and discovery.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Hashtag entity (often the hashtag text itself, e.g., 'campuslife').

postCount.description: Denormalized count of posts that use this hashtag.

eventCount.description: Denormalized count of events that use this hashtag.

lastUsedAt.description: Timestamp of the last time this hashtag was used in a post or event.

UserTimetable.title: UserTimetable
UserTimetable.description: Stores a student's personal course timetable, parsed from CSV or iCal, typically a sub-collection of UserProfile.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserTimetable entity (e.g., 'current' for the active timetable).

courses.description: An array of course slots, each describing a class with its details.

enableReminders.description: True if class reminders are enabled for this timetable.

lastUpdatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update or import of the timetable.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure for Dash — Campus Connect is designed with a strong emphasis on multi-tenancy, Authorization Independence, and support for secure `list` operations (QAPs - Rules are not Filters). All top-level collections are namespaced under `/universities/{universityId}` to enforce strict campus isolation, ensuring that data from one university is never exposed to another.

**Authorization Independence & Denormalization:**

1.  **University-Level Isolation:** Every document includes a `universityId` field, allowing Firestore security rules to easily enforce that `request.resource.data.universityId == universityId` (from the path) and `request.auth.uid` belongs to that university (by checking `get(/universities/{universityId}/userProfiles/$(request.auth.uid)).data.universityId`). This avoids `get()` calls for cross-university checks.

2.  **Self-Contained Authorization for Subcollections:** A critical mandate is to avoid hierarchical authorization dependencies (`get()`) that rely on a parent document's attributes for a subcollection's access. To achieve this, key authorization fields from parent documents are *denormalized* into their subcollection documents:
    *   `Message` documents (under `conversations/{conversationId}/messages`) explicitly contain `participantIds` from their parent `Conversation` to authorize reads/writes without needing to `get()` the parent conversation.
    *   `EventPhoto` documents (under `events/{eventId}/photos`) contain `eventRsvpGoingUserIds` and `eventCheckedInUserIds` from their parent `Event` to control who can view or upload photos to the album.
    *   `HelpDeskReply` documents (under `helpDeskTickets/{ticketId}/replies`) contain `ticketSubmitterId`, `ticketAssignedToUserId`, and `ticketIsWellbeingTicket` from their parent `HelpDeskTicket` to enable appropriate access for the submitter and assigned admins.
    This denormalization ensures that each document carries its full authorization context, simplifying security rules and preventing issues with atomic operations.

3.  **Path-Based Ownership:** For private user data like `notifications` and `userTimetables`, a path structure like `/universities/{universityId}/userProfiles/{userId}/notifications/{notificationId}` is used. This makes ownership explicit, allowing security rules to simply check `request.auth.uid == userId` for granular control.

4.  **Membership Maps:** For collaborative data like `Conversations` and `Clubs`, `participantIds`, `memberUserIds`, or `moderatorUserIds` arrays are stored directly on the document. Rules can efficiently check `request.auth.uid in resource.data.participantIds` for authorization.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters) Support:**

To enable secure `list` operations without relying on client-side filtering:

1.  **Explicit Audience Fields:** For `Post` and `Announcement` entities, fields like `audience` (`'Everyone'`, `'Followers only'`) and detailed `targetType` (`'All Students'`, `'By Year'`, `'By Faculty'`) are stored directly on the documents. This allows security rules to filter `list` queries based on these fields.

2.  **Requesting User's Profile for Permissions:** In cases like a 'Followers only' post, where access depends on the *requesting user's* relationship to the author, the security rules can perform a `get()` call to `request.auth.uid`'s own `UserProfile` document to retrieve their `followingIds` array. This is a deliberate and controlled exception to the 'AVOID get()' principle for *read* operations, as it inspects the *requester's own* attributes rather than external document dependencies, making the `list` operation secure and adhering to QAPs.

3.  **DBAC (Database Access Control):** User roles (`student`, `admin`, `superadmin`, `wellbeing_admin`) are stored directly in the `UserProfile` document. Security rules utilize `get(/universities/{universityId}/userProfiles/$(request.auth.uid)).data.role` to determine administrative privileges for accessing collections like `reports`, `moderationLogs`, or restricted `helpDeskTickets`. This approach keeps roles in the database, simplifying management without relying on custom claims.
